description:
Summary:

Previous the allow_tf32 heuristics depended on some general alignment heuristics which do not capture the whole set of cases where cuBLAS might not use TF32. This allowed significant numerical regressions for certain jobs that used max-autotune

The result of the new heuristics was from doing analytical reverse engineering of cuBLAS's heuristics from processing > 2M shapes and different layouts with the following script https://pastebin.com/5Kz4aJit

Test Plan: CI

Reviewed By: nmacchioni
